\documentclass{article}
% A branch on an unknown inside a helper, met once shallow and then deeper in
% groups within one call: the deeper meets are later calls, not passes of a
% loop entered at the first, so no group the caller opened may be unwound.
\newcount\mode \mode=7
\edef\v{\ifodd\pdfuniformdeviate 2 x\else y\fi}
\def\w{x}
\def\style{\ifx\v\w\relax\fi}
\def\out{\bgroup\style\egroup}
\def\leaveall{\ifnum\mode=0 \expandafter\endgroup\else\egroup\expandafter\leaveall\fi}
\newcommand*\code[1]{\begingroup\mode=0 \style\bgroup\mode=1 \out\out\out\out #1\leaveall}
\begin{document}
Some text \code{a}, \code{b} and \code{c}.
\gdef\AfterCode{}
\input{zzlater}
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
